attr.title: EAT GIRL
attr.desc: EAT GIRL is a surreal top-down action game about moving quickly and efficiently through tight corridors while eating dots. Explore an interconnected world of more than 30 levels, meet creatures who may or may not be docile, and take in an atmosphere that is by turns meditative and unsettling, with every level scored by its own blend of ambient music.
attr.inst: Buy EAT GIRL on itch (https://tesselode.itch.io/eatgirl), then copy 'eatgirl.love' from the download into ports/eatgirl.
